run_fit_references_cli: run the fit_references script with a config yaml file to fit and save linear element references
run_fit_linref_function: run the fit_linref function with a config dict and output path to fit linear references from a training dataset
fit_linear_references_from_config: fit linear element references for specified targets using a training dataset and save checkpoints
save_element_reference_checkpoints: save fitted element reference state dicts as checkpoint files to the specified output directory
load_config_for_fitting: load a configuration yaml file with duplicate key detection for fitting linear element references
